arxiv-2111-10355.creator: Tristan C. Collins, Sergei Gukov, Sebastien Picard, Shing-Tung Yau
arxiv-2111-10355.description: Abstract . We construct special Lagrangian 3-spheres in non-Kähler compact threefolds equipped with the Fu-Li-Yau geometry. These non-Kähler geometries emerge from topological transitions of compact Calabi-Yau threefolds. From this point of view, a conifold transition exchanges holomorphic 2-cycles for special Lagrangian 3-cycles. 1.

arxiv-2201-00923.title: Robust Private Supply of a Public Good
arxiv-2201-00923.creator: Wanchang Zhang
arxiv-2201-00923.description: Abstract We study the mechanism design problem of selling a public good to a group of agents by a principal in the correlated private value environment. We assume the principal only knows the expectations of the agents’ values, but does not know the joint distribution of the values.

arxiv-2205-00905.title: FastGCL: Fast Self-Supervised Learning on Graphs via Contrastive Neighborhood Aggregation
arxiv-2205-00905.creator: Yuansheng Wang, Wangbin Sun, Kun Xu, Zulun Zhu, Liang Chen*, Zibin Zheng
arxiv-2205-00905.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Yuansheng Wang, Wangbin Sun, Kun Xu, Zulun Zhu, Liang Chen*, Zibin Zheng. Graph contrastive learning (GCL), as a popular approach to graph self-supervised learning, has recently achieved a non-negligible effect. To achieve superior performance, the majority of existing GCL methods elaborate on graph data augmentation to construct appropriate contrastive pairs. However, existing methods place more emphasis on the complex graph data augmentation which requires extra time overhead, and pay less attention to developing contrastive schemes specific to encoder characteristics.

arxiv-2308-08826.title: The Bäcklund transforms of Peterson’s isometric deformations of diagonal higher dimensional quadrics without center
arxiv-2308-08826.creator: Ion I. Dincă
arxiv-2308-08826.description: Abstract . We provide the Bäcklund transforms of Peterson’s isometric deformations of diagonal higher dimensional quadrics without center. These are found explicitly. can be iterated via the Bianchi Permutability Theorem and can be further iterated via the 3 3 -moving Möbius configuration, thus producing explicit solutions depending on arbitrarily many constants.

arxiv-2404-03785.title: The Galois group of a Special Group
arxiv-2404-03785.creator: Kaique Matias de Andrade Roberto Hugo L. Mariano
arxiv-2404-03785.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Kaique Matias de Andrade Roberto Hugo L. Mariano. In this ongoing work, we extend to a class of well-behaved pre-special hyperfields the work of J. Mináč and Spira ( [ 14 ] ) that describes a (pro-2)-group of a field extension that encodes the quadratic form theory of a given field F F : in [ 1 ] it is shown that its associated cohomology ring contains a copy of the cohomology ring of the field F F .

arxiv-2407-02514.title: LOGIC-LM++: Multi-Step Refinement for Symbolic Formulations
arxiv-2407-02514.creator: Shashank Kirtania, Priyanshu Gupta, Arjun Radhakrishna
arxiv-2407-02514.description: Abstract In this paper we examine the limitations of Large Language Models (LLMs) for complex reasoning tasks. Although recent works have started to employ formal languages as an intermediate representation for reasoning tasks, they often face challenges in accurately generating and refining these formal specifications to ensure correctness.

arxiv-2412-20462.title: Gravity induced entanglement of multiple massive particles with large spin
arxiv-2412-20462.creator: Kai Li 1,2, Yi Ling 1,2, Zhangping Yu 1,2,
arxiv-2412-20462.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Kai Li 1,2, Yi Ling 1,2, Zhangping Yu 1,2,. We investigate the generation rate of the quantum entanglement in a system composed of multiple massive particles with large spin, where the mass of a single particle can be split into multiple trajectories by a generalized Stern-Gerlach interferometer. Taking the coherent spin states (CSS) as the initial state and considering the gravitational interaction due to Newtonian potential, we compute the generation rate of the entanglement for different configurations of the setup.

arxiv-2502-04097.title: Impermanent loss and Loss-vs-Rebalancing II
arxiv-2502-04097.creator: Abe Alexander, Guillaume Lambert, Lars Fritz
arxiv-2502-04097.description: Abstract This paper examines the relationship between impermanent loss (IL) and loss-versus-rebalancing (LVR) in automated market makers (AMMs). Our main focus is on statistical properties, the impact of fees, the role of block times, and, related to the latter, the continuous time limit.

arxiv-2504-00352.title: Safe Navigation in Dynamic Environments Using Data-Driven Koopman Operators and Conformal Prediction
arxiv-2504-00352.creator: Kaier Liang, Guang Yang, Mingyu Cai, Cristian-Ioan Vasile
arxiv-2504-00352.description: Abstract We propose a novel framework for safe navigation in dynamic environments by integrating Koopman operator theory with conformal prediction. Our approach leverages data-driven Koopman approximation to learn nonlinear dynamics and employs conformal prediction to quantify uncertainty, providing statistical guarantees on approximation errors.

arxiv-2506-06077.title: Self driving algorithm for an active four wheel drive racecar
arxiv-2506-06077.creator: Gergely Bári a and László Palkovics b
arxiv-2506-06077.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Gergely Bári a and László Palkovics b. Controlling autonomous vehicles at their handling limits presents significant challenges, particularly for electric vehicles equipped with active four-wheel drive (A4WD) systems offering independent wheel torque control. While traditional Vehicle Dynamics Control (VDC) methods rely on complex physics-based models and intricate coordination strategies, this study explores the potential of Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) to develop unified, high-performance controllers for such systems.

arxiv-2511-19213.title: Characterizing the Impact of Active Queue Management on Speed Test Measurements
arxiv-2511-19213.creator: Siddhant Ray, Taveesh Sharma, Jonatas Marques, Paul Schmitt, Francesco Bronzino, Nick Feamster
arxiv-2511-19213.description: Abstract . Present day speed test tools measure peak throughput, but often fail to capture the user-perceived responsiveness of a network connection under load. Recently, platforms such as NDT, Ookla Speedtest and Cloudflare Speed Test have introduced metrics such as “latency under load” or “working latency” to fill this gap.

pmc-12472413.title: Strain-Dependent Thermoadaptation in the Fish Pathogen Aeromonas salmonicida subsp. salmonicida
pmc-12472413.creator: Kim C Fournier, Pierre-Étienne Marcoux, Antony T Vincent, Steve J Charette, Jarl Bøgwald
pmc-12472413.description: Strains of Aeromonas salmonicida subsp. salmonicida, a major pathogen of salmonids, typically do not grow at temperatures above 30 °C. The effects of thermal stress on this bacterium have been extensively studied. Recently, we demonstrated that repeated exposure to cyclical thermal stress, reaching up to 37 °C, can induce permanent thermoadaptation in certain strains of this bacterium.

pmc-12515606.title: Mapping Metabolic Dysfunction-associated Steatotic Liver Disease Models of Care across 17 Middle East and North Africa Countries: Insights into Guidelines, Infrastructure, and Referral Systems
pmc-12515606.creator: Mohamed El-Kassas, Khalid M. AlNaamani, Rofida Khalifa, Yusuf Yilmaz, Asma Labidi, Maen Almattooq, Faisal M. Sanai, Maisam W.I. Akroush Nabil Debzi, Mohammed A. Medhat, Imam Waked, Ali Tumi, Mohamed Elbadry, Mohammed Omer Mohammed, Ala I. Sharara, Ali El Houni, Mohamed Alsenbesy, Hisham El-Khayat, M
pmc-12515606.description: Background and AimsMetabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) represents an escalating healthcare burden across the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region; however, system-level preparedness remains largely undefined. This study aimed to assess existing models of care, clinical infrastructure, policy frameworks, and provider perspectives across 17 MENA countries.

pmc-12552939.title: Retrospective Analysis of 1093 Non-Syndromic Supernumerary Teeth From 782 Patients in Northwest China: Clinical, Radiographic and Epidemiological Insights
pmc-12552939.creator: Xin Xue, Haozhen Wang, Tianyu Zhang, Wenlong Li, Xinwei Li, Shukai Sun, Lian Wu
pmc-12552939.description: Introduction and AimsThis study investigated the epidemiological, clinical and radiologic characteristics of non-syndromic supernumerary teeth (ST) using cone beam computed tomography (CBCT) and provided references for the clinical management of ST.MethodsClinical and CBCT image data from 782 patients (1093 ST) were collected.

pmc-12649170.title: The Contextualized Impact of Ethnic-Racial Socialization on Black and Latino Youth’s Self-Esteem and Ethnic-Racial Identity
pmc-12649170.creator: Ashley R. McDonald, Briah A. Glover, Olivia C. Goldstein, Dawn P. Witherspoon
pmc-12649170.description: This study examined how ethnic-racial socialization (ERS)—cultural-egalitarianism, preparation for bias, and promotion of mistrust—mediate the influence of neighborhood and parental cultural contexts on youth self-esteem and ethnic-racial identity (ERI). Participants included 184 youth (Mage = 13.38; 57.5% female) and 144 parents (Mage = 40.62) from Black and Latino families living in a new destination context.

While the large sample size and extended follow-up are commendable, we believe that several methodological limitations undermine the causal interpretation of the results.

pmc-12782334.title: Prevalence and Determinants of Polypharmacy: A Cross‐Sectional Study Among Elderly Patients With Cardiovascular Diseases in Outpatient Clinics
pmc-12782334.creator: Negin Faramarzi Nasab, Shahab Rezaeian, Saeed Ezadi, Alireza Khatony
pmc-12782334.description: Polypharmacy, commonly defined as the concurrent use of five or more medications, is a pressing public health concern among older adults with cardiovascular disease, given its strong association with adverse drug–drug interactions, medication errors, and increased hospitalization rates. Despite its clinical significance, evidence from low‐ and middle‐income countries, including Iran, remains limited.

pmc-13093505.title: Letter to the Editor, “Association Between Renal Function and Left Atrial Low‐Voltage Area Burden in Paroxysmal Atrial Fibrillation”
pmc-13093505.creator: Ahmed Raza, Shahzadi Gulfishan
pmc-13093505.description: ial fibrillation (AF). By demonstrating an inverse association between renal function and atrial substrate remodeling, the authors provide important insights into the interplay between chronic kidney disease (CKD) and atrial fibrosis, an area of growing relevance in contemporary electrophysiology. Their findings contribute meaningfully to pre‐ablation risk stratification and highlight the potential value of renal function in anticipating substrate complexity.

pmc-13371157.title: Genome-wide identification of the MYB gene family and identification of candidate genes that involved in anthocyanin synthesis in cowpea (Vigna unguiculata [L.] Walp)
pmc-13371157.creator: Lei Xia, Kai Wang, Feng Guan, Bo Shi, Xuetong Yang, Yuanyuan Xie, Xinjian Wan, Jingyun Zhang
pmc-13371157.description: MYB transcription factors are important for plant growth development and abiotic stress response, especially in anthocyanin synthesis. However, the comprehensive genome-wide analysis of the MYB gene family in cowpea is unclear. In this study, 227 VuMYB genes were identified in cowpea, including 62 1R-VuMYB, 161 2R-VuMYB, and 4 3R-VuMYB.

pmc-13438740.title: The impact of frailty on postoperative complications and resource utilization in patients with severe aortic stenosis undergoing transcatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVI)
pmc-13438740.creator: Hiroshi Yonekura, Tasuku Fujii, Koji Kawakami, Koichi Akiyama
pmc-13438740.description: Patients with severe aortic stenosis undergoing transcatheter aortic valve implantation are usually older adults with multiple comorbidities and often frail. Frailty reflects increased vulnerability to adverse outcomes and is an important factor in this population; however, its impact on postoperative complications and healthcare resource utilization remains uncertain.

pmc-13461041.title: Agentic AI in oncology: autonomous workflows for clinical decision support and evidence synthesis
pmc-13461041.creator: Saurav Kumar Mishra, Pragya Rai, John J. Georrge, Hamadou Mamoudou
pmc-13461041.description: al biology, the emergence of Agentic AI–systems capable of reasoning, iterative planning, and independent tool use via large language models (LLMs)–represents a distinct functional paradigm. This transition from assistive algorithm to autonomous “scientist-in-the-loop” warrants rigorous examination in the context of precision oncology workflows[1,2].

pmc-13516264.title: Supramolecular Complexation of Niclosamide and Nafamostat: Improved Physicochemical Profile and Enhanced Anticancer Effect
pmc-13516264.creator: Se-Eun Byeon, Rengarajan Baskaran, Young-Joon Park
pmc-13516264.description: Background/Objective: Niclosamide exhibits considerable potential for the treatment of drug-resistant cancers. However, its poor aqueous solubility substantially limits its oral bioavailability and therapeutic efficacy. To overcome this limitation, we developed a novel pharmaceutical supramolecular crystalline phase comprising niclosamide and nafamostat. Methods: In this study, we developed a niclosamide–nafamostat pharmaceutical supramolecular crystalline phase using a conventional solvent evaporation technique.
